jobs.title: Content Production Manager
jobs.description: About Progress Partners Progress Partners is a fast-growing technology company building and scaling next-generation SaaS and mobile platforms. We blend creativity with data-driven execution to ship high-impact products, including AI-powered tools, productivity platforms, and workflow software, used by millions of people in more than 160 countries. Our global team of experts in software development, product design, growth, and analytics collaborates across time zones to deliver category-defining innovations. We work end-to-end across the product lifecycle: design, build, launch, and scale. If you’re passionate about building transformative products, Progress Partners is a place to make a lasting impact. About the Role Hi, I’m Oleksandra , Head of Localization and Content at Progress Partners, and I’m hiring a Content Production Manager to join my team. We build consumer products ranging from utility tools to wellbeing and learning experiences, and many of them rely on rich in-app content, such as lessons, quizzes, stories, videos, and other formats, produced through a mix of AI workflows, in-house content specialists, and a network of freelancers. We’re now scaling that output across several products at once, and we need someone to own the engine full-time. You’ll run content production end to end, combining editorial judgment with strong project management to deliver high volumes of quality content on tight timelines. You’ll coordinate the work of our in-house content specialists and directly manage our freelance network, without direct reports initially. Progress Partners builds consumer web and mobile products used around the world, from utility tools to wellbeing and learning experiences, in up to 36 languages. The Content & Localization team aims to own every word users read across our products and funnels, in every market. We are building this team from the ground up. You'll join early, shape how we work, and see your impact directly in product and revenue metr

jobs.title: Binance Accelerator Program - User Communications Specialist (Chinese Content)
jobs.description: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world. About Binance Accelerator Program Binance Accelerator Program (BAP) is a 3-6 month internship program designed for Early Career talent to have firsthand experience in the rapidly expanding digital assets space. You will be given the opportunity to develop your skills at Binance and understand what it’s like to work at the world's leading blockchain ecosystem. As part of your internship in the BAP, there will also be opportunities for networking and development, which will expand your professional network and build transferable skills to propel you forward in your career. Learn about the BAP Program HERE . Who may apply Current university students and recent graduates. *Terms of employment / engagement shall be subject to contract and local applicable laws About the Role: As a User Communications Intern on the Binance User Comms team, you will help shape how millions of Chinese-speaking users experience Binance. You will review and refine the Chinese announcements and FAQs that business units publish to a global audience; ensuring every piece reads natively, and that it meets Binance's standards for accuracy, clarity, and tone. Your reviews will catch discrepancies against English source content before they reach users, and your feedback will help build the glossaries, guidelines, and AI-assisted tooling that raise the bar for Chinese content across the company. You will work closely with teams across every Binance

jobs.title: Senior Medical Writer
jobs.description: Senior Medical Writer (Publications or Medical Affairs) London ,Manchester, Macclesfield, Glasgow, Hybrid or UK remote   The power of three of the world s leading medical communications companies – Nucleus Global, ApotheCom and Ashfield MedComms – and the specialised services and skills within MEDiSTRAVA combine to form iNIZIO Medical. With over 2,000 employees globally, iNIZIO Medical creates compelling content and engage communities across the spectrum of healthcare. We improve scientific understanding and pioneer new ways of partnership, with a united vision to lead and define the future of medical in drug development and commercialisation. Due to continuing growth within iNIZIO Medical we have some fantastic opportunities to join our teams across Nucleus Global, ApotheCom and Ashfield MedComms. We are looking for a Senior Medical Writer with opportunities across multiple therapy areas. This role would suit an experienced Senior Medical Writer. It will provide a great career development opportunity for you with the support of a very experienced team. Reporting to a Scientific Director, you will develop scientific expertise in assigned therapeutic areas, supporting delivery for a versatile team. Core deliverable tasks include researching and developing technical materials, ensuring that a candidate or employee makes all outputs follow written brief, makes them accurate in content and editorial style, and references them. You will also communicate with clients and KOL on content development and attend scientific meetings. To succeed you will have: · Several years experience working within a medical communications agency environment. · An academic background in the life sciences (Bachelor of Science, Master of Science, Doctor of Philosophy)   We offer a great compensation package including pension, life insurance, private healthcare and paid time off. In addition to our benefits package, we are happy to talk flexible working with hybrid and remote working

jobs.title: Content Reviewer - United States
jobs.description: Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust. In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information. Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models Qualifications to succeed in this project: Professional fluency in English Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher) Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven prof

jobs.title: Freelance Writer
jobs.description: Our organization is seeking content writers to create articles and blog posts on a variety of topics. The rate of pay is $20 per 100 words (this comes out to approximately $100 per article or $50 per hour). Some topics you may be asked to write about include the following (you can always turn down a topic if you do not feel comfortable writing about it, however if you have experience or expertise in a specific area, please let us know): Health & beauty Fitness Home Decor Fashion Sports Do it yourself Finance Legal Medical Family/Parenting Relationships Real Estate Restaurants Contracting (plumbing, pool building, remodeling, etc.) These are just some of the more general industries and topics that we cover. Requirements : We ask that all work be completed using a word processor such as Microsoft Word or Open Office A reliable internet connection and the ability to meet deadlines Good communication skills and respond in a timely manner to editorial staff when they ask for updates on tasks, etc Work well as a team member with the rest of our content management and editorial staff Note : Applicants to this job signaled that accessing some writing tasks may require payment.
